description:
THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE FOR INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. This announcement closes 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, 23 April 2026. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this requirement is 562211, Hazardous Waste Treatment and Disposal, with a corresponding size standard of $47M. Interested parties must be registered under NAICS 562211 in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. The Government plans to consider all information submitted in response to this Sources Sought Notice.

Please see the attached notice for additional details.
